info.title: SupportSeal Workspace API v1 (DRAFT, phase 1)
info.summary: Planned agent-first API surface. Nothing in this file is implemented.
info.description:
DRAFT contract for phase 1 of the agent-first Workspace API (ADR-0005, docs/agent-api-plan.md). Not implemented and not checked by openapi-drift.test.ts: that test requires every path in docs/openapi.json to equal an existing src/app/api/products route, so unimplemented paths cannot live there. Each implementing slice moves its operations into openapi.json and extends the drift test to the /api/v1 route tree in the same PR; this file is deleted when empty.

Security rules this contract encodes: the Workspace comes only from the bearer token (no operation takes a workspaceId); an id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404, same body and headers); cursors are opaque and signed; lists return no totals; attachments are served only with the bearer token.

Every error uses the existing envelope. New error codes: invalid_cursor (400), idempotency_conflict (409), idempotency_in_flight (409), service_paused (402).

get.description: v1 envelope. The legacy GET /api/products keeps its {products:[...]} shape.

post.description: 409 is idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_flight or product_limit_reached (100 Products per Workspace). Phase 2 adds the `installation` block (widget snippet, script URL, inbound email address, form endpoint), with origins derived from the request.

get.summary: List Conversations, oldest first (the inbox order)

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: A Product of another Workspace answers 404, exactly like an unknown one; it is never an empty list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search within the Workspace only. `SS-123`, `#123` and `123` match a ticket number.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Conversation id. An id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404).

patch.summary: Change status and tags together or not at all

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Conversation id. An id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404).

delete.summary: Delete a Conversation and its attachments

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Conversation id. An id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404).

get.summary: List a Conversation's Messages, oldest first

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Conversation id. An id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404).

post.summary: Send a reply or add an internal note
post.description: A reply uses the dashboard reply path (chat or email), reopens a Closed Conversation and is refused with 402 service_paused while the Free plan is paused. Notes are allowed during the pause and never reach the customer. Idempotency-Key is required.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Conversation id. An id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404).

put.summary: Assign or unassign (slice 1f, after the assignment schema)
put.description: BLOCKED: not part of phase 1. Depends on the V2 assignment schema (open question AA4) and ships with it.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Conversation id. An id from another Workspace answers exactly like an unknown id (404).

delete.summary: Delete a Contact and its data

post.summary: Upload a staged attachment, then reference it from a message
post.description: multipart/form-data with a `file` part and a `conversationId` part; the Product comes from the Conversation and a foreign conversationId answers 404. MIME is validated server-side, never by extension; size limits follow FR-FILE-01. A staged attachment that is never referenced is removed.

get.summary: Download an attachment (bearer token required; no public or signed URL exists)

200.description: The file, sent with Content-Disposition: attachment and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

get.summary: List the Workspace's tokens (never their secrets)

post.summary: Create a token; the secret is returned once
post.description: Scopes must be a subset of the caller's and never include tokens:admin (granted only in the dashboard). expiresAt is required (default 90 days, maximum 365 days); null is refused.

delete.summary: Revoke a token (idempotent; a token may revoke itself)

bearerAuth.description: A Workspace API token (`ss_live_...`). The token alone determines the Workspace and the allowed operations (x-required-scope on each operation).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from nextCursor. Any other value is 400 invalid_cursor.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1-128 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Scoped to Workspace, token, method and resolved path (ids included); kept 24 hours. Same key and body replays the stored response (Idempotent-Replayed: true); same key and a different body is 409 idempotency_conflict.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required: this operation has an outward side effect (email or message). See IdempotencyKey.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired token (indistinguishable).

error.message: Missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired token (indistinguishable).

InsufficientScope.description: The token lacks the scope this operation needs.

error.message: The token lacks the scope this operation needs.

NotFound.description: Unknown id, or an id that belongs to another Workspace. The two are byte-identical.

error.message: Unknown id, or an id that belongs to another Workspace. The two are byte-identical.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed body, unknown field or bad filter; or invalid_cursor: a cursor that is tampered, truncated, or from another Workspace, route or filter set fails identically.

error.message: Malformed body, unknown field or bad filter; or invalid_cursor: a cursor that is tampered, truncated, or from another Workspace, route or filter set fails identically.

Conflict.description: idempotency_conflict (same Idempotency-Key, different body), idempotency_in_flight, or conflict.

error.message: idempotency_conflict (same Idempotency-Key, different body), idempotency_in_flight, or conflict.

ProductConflict.description: idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_flight, or product_limit_reached (the Workspace already has 100 Products).

error.message: idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_flight, or product_limit_reached (the Workspace already has 100 Products).

ServicePaused.description: Free-plan pause: agent replies are refused until the Workspace upgrades. Notes, tags and status still work.

error.message: Free-plan pause: agent replies are refused until the Workspace upgrades. Notes, tags and status still work.
